تنتهجوا (form VII)
# تَنْتَهِجُوا (tantahijū) /tan.ta.hi.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
# تُنْتَهَجُوا (tuntahajū) /tun.ta.ha.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَجَ (intahaja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
